name: menu-bar
title: Menu Bar Items
description: Every menu item of the app in front as one searchable list: File > Export > PDF with its shortcut; Enter presses it. macOS, over Accessibility.
author: pal

store.tagline: The front app's menus, searched and pressed from one list
features: Live: the menus of the app in front are read every time the panel shows, so `export pdf` at the root finds Safari's or Preview's item without opening the palette
One row per enabled item: the title, the menus above it as the subtitle, the shortcut as key caps, a check mark when it is on, a section per top menu in menu order
Enter presses the item through Accessibility after pal hides, so a sheet or a dialog it opens lands in the app; the HUD names what was pressed
Separators, disabled items and the Apple menu are left out; menus deeper than four levels or past 150 ms of reading are cut, so a slow app never delays the panel
Without Accessibility the one row opens System Settings on the pane; on Linux it says the menu bar is macOS only

screenshots.caption: TextEdit's menus in one list: a section per menu, the path as the subtitle, shortcuts as key caps
A checked item carries its mark; Enter Full Screen shows its Globe key
Typing narrows by the whole path: font finds every Format > Font item
The rows are root results too: export from the root, no palette first

actions.title: Press
actions.description: Hides the panel, then presses the item in the app.

menu-bar.description: The menus of the app in front; Enter presses the item.
